capture_type: Selected fields from saved native Splunk job JSON

content.search:
| makeresults count=100
| streamstats count as rownum
| eval query=case(((rownum>=1 AND rownum<=34)), "alpha.xyz", ((rownum>=35 AND rownum<=67)), "beta.xyz", ((rownum>=68 AND rownum<=100)), "gamma.xyz"),
    _time=1735689660,
    host="host-a",
    index="dns",
    sourcetype="dns:query"
| fields query _time host index sourcetype
| search index=dns sourcetype=dns:query
| eval tld=lower(replace(query, ".*\\.([A-Za-z0-9-]+)$", "\1"))
| where tld IN ("xyz","pw","top")
| eval sld=lower(replace(query, ".*\\.([A-Za-z0-9-]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)$", "\1"))
| bucket _time span=10m
| stats count as qps, dc(sld) as sld_cnt, values(sld) as sld_set by host, _time
| where qps >= 100 AND sld_cnt >= 3
